desc: Orlivane dog hind-leg sleeves connect a neck and back panel to two long rear-leg sleeves. The black stretch polyester garment covers both hind legs to above the ankles while leaving the front legs, chest and most of the belly open. Hook-and-loop closures adjust at the neck and belly. The design helps keep dogs from licking or biting hind-leg wounds and bandages. Available in XS, S, M, L and XL; measure your dog and compare all four measurements with the size chart before ordering.
b: HIND-LEG COVERAGE — Two long sleeves cover both hind legs to above the ankles, helping keep your dog from licking or biting hind-leg wounds and bandages.
CONNECTED DESIGN — A one-piece neck and back panel connects both hind-leg sleeves, instead of relying on a single strap or ankle-only fastening.
ADJUSTABLE FIT — Hook-and-loop closures at the neck and belly let you adjust the fit. The chest and most of the belly remain open, with the front legs uncovered.
STRETCHY POLYESTER — Black stretch polyester fabric forms the neck/back panel and both hind-leg sleeves. This is a hind-leg garment with an open chest and belly.
FIVE SIZES — Choose XS, S, M, L or XL. Measure chest, back length, neck and leg length, then check the size chart before ordering. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
